[[File:PlaytimeRewardsIcon.png|150px|thumb]] ==Description== '''Playtime Rewards''' are rewards given out for playing the game. As the player is in the lobby or in a match, a timer will start, and upon going for a specific amounts of time, it will give players a reward that can be accepted in the lobby. The rewards are split into tiers shown off by the giftbox icons. Each one can give out multiple rewards at once. The rewards are random item from a specific pool of items tied to that tier. Randomly, an option to watch an ad for an additional reward may appear. It will allow the player to get additional two blue giftboxes and one green giftbox with rewards.
